name: CameraToView
title: Camera to view
summary: Moves the camera to a preset view. Ignored while `cameraLocked` is set.

args.name: moveType
args.allowed: 0 = jump, 1 = move over time. Other = no camera change (side effects of the view still happen)
args.meaning: how to reach the view. Seen: 1, once 0

args.name: frames
args.meaning: steps of the move (camera move timing). Also the duration of the sprite rescale of views 14 and 19. Seen: 0..200, mostly 16 and 24

args.name: easeCount
args.meaning: steps before the speed halves, 0 = never. Seen: 8, 0, 12, 6..90

name: CameraToPoint
title: Camera to point
summary: Moves the camera eye and look-at point to given coordinates. Applies the current layout mode (command 4) first.

args.name: moveType
args.allowed: 0 = jump to the point, 1 = move to the point, 2 = move by the given amounts (added to the current eye and target). Other = no move

name: OrbitCamera
title: Orbit camera
summary: Turns the camera eye around the look-at point.

args.name: moveType
args.allowed: 0 = jump, 1 = move over time. Other = nothing

args.name: dPitch
args.meaning: added to the elevation angle (the one that sets eye height). aletheia's local name `yaw` is wrong, the camera function calls it dPitch. Seen: 0, -0x7D0

args.name: dYaw
args.meaning: added to the horizontal angle around the y axis. Seen: 0x2000, -0x2000, -0x3E80

name: CameraShake
title: Camera shake
summary: Shakes the camera eye and target along one screen axis. The aletheia name is misleading: `BTLV_CAMERA_StartMoveWithEasing` starts a mover in kind 3 (swing both ways).

args.name: unused
args.meaning: passed on and ignored by the camera. Seen: 0, 0x1000, 0x333

args.name: waves
args.meaning: number of full waves (reversals = waves x 4). Seen: 1..18

name: SpriteLayoutMode
title: Sprite layout mode
summary: Switches the Pokemon sprites between flat (orthographic) and 3D drawing.

args.name: mode
args.allowed: scope 0: 1 = 3D (ortho off), other = flat (ortho on). Scope nonzero: 1 = billboard off, other = billboard on

args.name: scope
args.allowed: 0 = all sprites (stores `layoutMode`, used by later camera commands). Nonzero = the attacker's sprite only (selector B 14)

name: SaveCamera
title: Save camera
summary: Stores the current eye and target for camera view 13. No arguments.

name: LoadParticles
title: Load particles
summary: Loads a particle member into a free slot (16 slots) and waits until its textures are uploaded. Loading a key that is already loaded does nothing.

args.name: key
args.allowed: member index of `a/0/0/6` (0..732), or a typed key

name: ParticleEffect
title: Particle effect
summary: Starts one emitter of a loaded particle file at a battler, aimed at another. World space.

args.name: offsetY
args.meaning: added to the y of source and dest. Seen: 0x2000 mostly, -0x1000..0xA000

name: ParticleEffectAtPoint
title: Particle effect at point
summary: Starts one emitter between two fixed points. World space. The multi-emitter rule does not apply.

name: ParticleEffectScreenSpace
title: Particle effect (screen space)
summary: Like 7, but positions are projected to the screen (projection mode 1) and the offset is a full vector. Sets up a screen camera for the particle system on first use.

args.name: source
args.allowed: see PS. 13 = attacker with projection mode 2

args.name: offsetY
args.meaning: added before projection, and to dest y. Seen: 0x2000 mostly

name: AllParticleEffects
title: All particle effects
summary: Starts every emitter block of the file (index 0 to count - 1), all with the same anchors.

name: UnloadParticles
title: Unload particles
summary: Deletes the particle system of a key and frees its slot. Live effects of that key stop.

args.name: key
args.allowed: a loaded key. Not loaded = nothing

name: ParticleEffectOnPath
title: Particle effect on path
summary: Starts one emitter that travels from source to dest (world space).

args.name: offsetY
args.meaning: added to both y. Seen: 0x2000 mostly

args.name: travelTime
args.allowed: 0x1000 and up. 0 = no travel, the emitter stays at the source
args.meaning: trip length in frames, 0x1E000 = 30. Seen: 0 (42 times), 0x10000..0xB4000

args.name: wobble
args.meaning: wave count for motion 5 and 6, 0x1000 = one wave. Seen: 0, 0x3000..0x5000

name: ParticleEffectOnPathFromPoint
title: Particle effect on path from point
summary: Like 12, but the start is a fixed point.

name: ParticleEffectOnPathScreenSpace
title: Particle effect on path (screen space)
summary: Like 12 with projection mode 3 and a screen camera.

name: ParticleEffectOnPathFromPointScreenSpace
title: Particle effect on path from point (screen space)
summary: Like 13 with projection mode 3. The last three words are in a different order than 12..14 and there is no wobble word.

args.name: motion
args.allowed: motion kind 0..6. 5 and 6 have no wave here (wobble stays 0)

name: OrbitingParticleEffect
title: Orbiting particle effect
summary: Starts one emitter that circles a center point in the xz plane (world space). Reads its 10 arguments through `BTLV_EFFVM_SetupEmitterCallbacks` with mode 0.

args.name: anchor
args.allowed: 0, 1 = attacker (selector S 14). 2, 3 = defender (selector S 16). 4, 5 = world origin. Odd = turn the other way

args.name: height
args.meaning: added to the center y. Seen: -0x1000, 0, 0x1000

args.name: pause
args.meaning: frames paused after each full turn. Seen: 0

name: OrbitingParticleEffectScreenSpace
title: Orbiting particle effect (screen space)
summary: Same as 16 with mode 1: the orbit point is projected to the screen and a screen camera is set up. The aletheia names "Source" and "Target" do not match the behavior: the difference is the projection, not the anchor.

args.name: anchor
args.allowed: 0, 1 = attacker (selector S 14). 2, 3 = defender (selector S 16). 4, 5 = world origin. Odd = turn the other way

args.name: height
args.meaning: added to the center y. Seen: -0x1000, 0, 0x1000

args.name: pause
args.meaning: frames paused after each full turn. Seen: 0

name: MovePokemon
title: Move Pokemon
summary: Moves each selected sprite. z is always 0 here (see 33 for a full vector).

args.name: kind
args.meaning: 1 = move by the offset (x mirrored on the opponent side). 0 = jump to the absolute point (x, y, 0). 5, 6 = back to the home spot. Seen: 2, 1, 5, 3

args.name: x
args.meaning: offset, swing size or target x. Seen: -0x1E000..0xC000, mostly 0x333..0x1000

args.name: repeat
args.meaning: round trips (kind 2) or waves (kind 3). Unused by kinds 0, 1. Seen: 0..32

name: ShakePokemon
title: Shake Pokemon
summary: Moves the sprite's draw offset along a sine path in one plane, cycle after cycle. Shares the position task, so it replaces a running 18 or 20 on that sprite.

args.name: mode
args.allowed: bit 0: run backwards. Bits 1-2: plane, 0 = z/y, 1 = x/z, 2 = x/y

args.name: waveStart
args.meaning: which quarter of the wave starts the motion (each picks a different sin/cos offset so the sprite starts at rest). Seen: 0, 2, 1, 3

args.name: amplitudeA
args.meaning: size along the first plane axis. Seen: 0..0x4000

args.name: amplitudeB
args.meaning: size along the second plane axis. Seen: 0..0x4000

args.name: cycles
args.allowed: 1 and up. 0 = the command does nothing

name: BouncePokemon
title: Bounce Pokemon
summary: Moves the sprite's draw offset by amplitude x sin(phase) while phase runs from start to end, then resets the offset to 0.

args.name: frames
args.allowed: 1 and up. 0 divides by zero and never ends

name: ScalePokemon
title: Scale Pokemon
summary: Tweens the sprite field that aletheia calls `shadowScale`. `MCSS_Draw` multiplies the main sprite's x and y size by it (mcss.c near lines 1077 and 1093), so this is the usual Pokemon scale command. Whether the shadow also follows is not checked.

args.name: kind
args.meaning: 1 = to the absolute scale, 2 = swing by the value. Seen: 2, 1, 0, 3

args.name: x
args.meaning: target or swing size on x. Seen: -0x1000..0x1666

args.name: y
args.meaning: target or swing size on y. Seen: -0x1000..0x1333

name: RotatePokemon
title: Rotate Pokemon
summary: Tweens the sprite's z rotation (screen plane).

args.name: kind
args.meaning: 1 = to the absolute angle. 2, 3 = swing, mirrored on the opponent side. Seen: 3, 2, 1

args.name: angle
args.meaning: 0xAAAA00 = 15 degrees, 0xFFFF000 = full turn. Seen: plus or minus 0x71C6AB, 0xAAAA00, 0xE38D55, 0xFFFF000

name: FadePokemon
title: Fade Pokemon
summary: Tweens the sprite's polygon alpha.

name: MosaicPokemon
title: Mosaic Pokemon
summary: Tweens the sprite's mosaic size. Every change reloads the sprite graphics.

name: PokemonEyeBlink
title: Pokemon eye blink
summary: Controls the sprite's blink layer (MCSS "mepachi" flag, the closed-eyes frame).

args.name: kind
args.allowed: 2 = timed blinking, 3 = blink on, 4 = blink off. Other = nothing

name: PausePokemonAnimation
title: Pause Pokemon animation
summary: Stops or resumes the sprite's own animation.

args.name: mode
args.allowed: 0 = resume, 1 = stop, 2 = stop (always flag), 3 = resume (clear always flag). Other = resume

name: TintPokemon
title: Tint Pokemon
summary: Blends the sprite palette toward a color, step by step.

args.name: step
args.allowed: 0 and up = frames between steps, one level per step. Negative n = (1 - n) levels per frame

args.name: mode
args.allowed: 0 = show, 1 = hide, 2 = toggle, 3 = hide and remember whether it was already hidden, 4 = undo mode 3, 5 = restore the states saved by the battle for positions 0..7

name: ScalePokemonDrawScale
title: Scale Pokemon (draw scale)
summary: Same arguments as 21, but the task tweens the sprite's `drawScale` field, another size multiplier in `MCSS_Draw`. The start value is read from `shadowScale`, not `drawScale`.

name: RemoveSprites
title: Remove sprites
summary: Removes the sprites of the selected battlers.

name: AddTrainerSprite
title: Add trainer sprite
summary: Adds a trainer sprite at a trainer position. The aletheia name says Pokemon, but it calls `BTLV_MCSS_AddTrainer`.

args.name: position
args.meaning: trainer spot. The code writes `pokeSprite[pos - 8]`. Seen: 8, 10, 12

args.name: x
args.meaning: position. x, y, z all 0 = the spot's default position. Seen: -0x40000..-0xA000

name: MoveTrainerSprite
title: Move trainer sprite
summary: Position tween with a full xyz vector for a trainer sprite.

name: PlaySpriteAnimation
title: Play sprite animation
summary: Starts animation sequence N on a sprite and marks it pending until the sequence ends (wait mode 4).

args.name: anim
args.allowed: 0 .. sequence count - 1. Out of range = nothing

name: RemoveTrainerSprite
title: Remove trainer sprite
summary: Removes the sprite and frees the trainer spot.

name: EffectBackground
title: Effect background
summary: Loads an effect background into BG3 and saves the BG3 scroll. The battle graphics are reloaded when the script ends.

args.name: file
args.allowed: first of a file triple in archive 0x5F (`a/0/9/5`, 165 members)
args.meaning: screen map (NSCR) = file, character data (NCGR) = file + 1, palette (NCLR, loaded into the palette fade buffer) = file + 2. aletheia's `ARC_UTIL_UploadBgPaletteFromArchive` really uploads a screen (it calls `NNS_G2dGetUnpackedScreenData`). Seen: 0..126, all multiples of 3

name: ScrollBackground
title: Scroll background
summary: Scrolls BG3.

args.name: kind
args.meaning: 1 = move by (x, y). 2 = swing. 4 = add (x, y) every frame, x negated when the attacker is on the opponent side. Seen: 4, 2, 1

args.name: x
args.meaning: distance, swing size or per-frame speed. Seen: -0x640..0x960

args.name: frames
args.meaning: steps per leg, or frames of kind 4. Seen: 1..240

name: NoOp4Words
title: No-op (4 words)
summary: Reads and drops 4 words.

name: NoOp5Words
title: No-op (5 words)
summary: Reads and drops 5 words.

name: BG3Priority
title: BG3 priority
summary: Sets the BG3 draw priority. The aletheia name is misleading. Priority goes back to 0 when the script ends.

name: BackgroundBlend
title: Background blend
summary: Writes the main-screen alpha blend. Only the third word is used. Blending is reset when the script ends.

args.name: level
args.meaning: other values: first targets 10, second targets 0x35, weight A 31, weight B = level

name: TintStage
title: Tint stage
summary: Blends the 3D stage, the 3D field or the background palettes toward a color.

args.name: scope
args.allowed: 0 = stage (platforms), 1 = field (3D background), 2 = both, 3 = BG palettes (palette fade, mask 0xFF00), 4 = all three

args.name: interval
args.meaning: stage and field: frames between steps, one level per step. BG palettes: passed as an s8 step, same rule as 27. Seen: 0..6

args.name: layer
args.allowed: 0 = both platforms, 1 = field (3D background), 2 = BG3 plane, 3 = platform 0, 4 = platform 1
args.meaning: . Platform 0 and 1 are the two stage models, which side each is was not checked. Seen: 0..4

name: WindowWipe
title: Window wipe
summary: Opens or closes a screen window rectangle one pixel per edge per step. Hides BG1 and BG2. The aletheia name says fade, but it drives the window registers.

args.name: direction
args.allowed: 0 = grow vertically (top up, bottom down), 1 = shrink vertically, 2 = grow horizontally, 3 = shrink horizontally

args.name: edgeX
args.allowed: high byte = left, low byte = right
args.meaning: start x range. Low byte 0xFF also enables window 1. Seen: 0xFF

args.name: edgeY
args.allowed: high byte = top, low byte = bottom

args.name: layers
args.allowed: bits 0-5 = layers inside windows 0 and 1, bits 8-13 = layers outside
args.meaning: WININ and WINOUT layer bits. Seen: 0x171F

args.name: keepWindow
args.allowed: 0 = switch windows off at the end

name: CellActorAtBattler
title: Cell actor at battler
summary: Loads a 2D cell actor from archive 0x5F at a battler's screen point.

args.name: slot
args.meaning: script actor slot. No range check

args.name: kind
args.meaning: 0 = jump to screen point (x, y). 1 = move by (x, y). Seen: 1, 3

name: ScaleCellActor
title: Scale cell actor
summary: Scales an actor, starting from 1.0. Turns on affine mode.

args.name: seq
args.allowed: 0..65535 (u16), must exist in the cell animation

name: TintCellActor
title: Tint cell actor
summary: Palette fade on the actor's palette (palette fade system, object palettes).

name: RemoveCellActor
title: Remove cell actor
summary: Releases the actor and marks the slot free. All slots are also released when the script ends.

name: HPGauges
title: HP gauges
summary: Shows, hides or slides the HP gauges.

args.name: action
args.allowed: 0 = hide, 1 = show, 2 = place 0x80 px off home (slid out), 3 and up = place 0x10 px off home. Offsets are negated on the opponent side

name: PlaySoundEffect
title: Play sound effect
summary: Plays a sound sequence now or after a delay. Does nothing while sound effects are suppressed. All sound effects are stopped when the script ends.

args.name: se
args.allowed: sound sequence id. The SE range of the sound archive is 0x546..0x81A

args.name: volume
args.meaning: player volume (`NNS_SndHandleSetVolume`). Vanilla often starts at 0 and raises it with 55. Seen: 0..127

args.name: modDepth
args.meaning: track modulation depth. 0 = do not touch modulation. Seen: 0, 5..200, 2000

args.name: modSpeed
args.meaning: track modulation speed, only used when modDepth is not 0. Seen: 0..127

name: PanSoundAcross
title: Pan sound across
summary: Ramps the pan of a playing sound from one battler's side to another's. The aletheia name says volume, but the task always ramps pan (param 2).

args.name: from
args.meaning: start side. Odd result = pan 127, even = -128. Seen: 14, 16, 0

args.name: delay
args.meaning: frames before the first step. Seen: 0..131

args.name: steps
args.meaning: steps from start to end. Seen: 5..240

args.name: passes
args.meaning: mode 1: one-way passes = passes x 2, 0 counts as 1 pass pair. Seen: 0

name: RampSound
title: Ramp sound
summary: Ramps the pitch, volume or pan of a playing sound between two plain values.

args.name: from
args.allowed: pitch: signed, unit unknown. Volume: 0..127. Pan: -128..127

name: WaitUntilIdle
title: Wait until idle
summary: Pauses the script until the systems of the wait mode are idle. The aletheia name is swapped with 57: this one does not count frames.

name: WaitFrames
title: Wait frames
summary: Pauses the script for a number of frames. The aletheia name is swapped with 56.

name: FramePacing
title: Frame pacing
summary: Sets the value every later command returns.

args.name: yield
args.allowed: 1 = one command per frame (default). 0 = run the next commands in the same frame

name: JumpIfValue
title: Jump if value
summary: Compares a condition value with a constant and jumps.

args.name: offset
args.meaning: jump distance from the end of this command. Seen: 6..0x66C

name: JumpIfValuesCompare
title: Jump if values compare
summary: Compares two condition values and jumps.

args.name: offset
args.meaning: from the end of this command. Seen: 46

name: JumpIfSpritePresent
title: Jump if sprite present
summary: Jumps when "a sprite is loaded at position" equals the expected value.

args.name: expected
args.allowed: 0 = jump when absent, 1 = jump when present

args.name: offset
args.meaning: from the end of this command. Seen: 6..0xB2

name: SetScriptVariable
title: Set script variable
summary: Sets `scriptVar` (condition 16, trainer type -1 of command 32).

name: ReadValueIntoScriptVariable
title: Read value into script variable
summary: `scriptVar` = condition value.

name: SetParameter
title: Set parameter
summary: Writes one effect parameter or flag.

args.name: value
args.allowed: per field (u8, u16, int, or 1 bit)

name: SubstituteDoll
title: Substitute doll
summary: Swaps the sprite graphics to the substitute doll or back. The argument order is not target first.

args.name: show
args.allowed: 0 = restore the Pokemon, nonzero = show the doll

args.name: setSwapped
args.allowed: nonzero = also set (show) or clear (restore) the swapped flag
args.meaning: the swapped flag makes later move effects run the fallback script first. Seen: 0, 1

name: CopyDefenderLookToAttacker
title: Copy defender look to attacker
summary: The attacker's sprite takes the defender's graphics, adjusted for front and back views. No arguments.

name: PlayCry
title: Play cry
summary: Plays the Pokemon cry of each selected battler, now or after a delay. Lowers the music while the cry plays.

args.name: pitch
args.meaning: added to the voice frequency (`PM_VOICE_AddFrequency`). Auto = -0xA00 when the sprite was loaded in the low-HP state, else 0. Seen: 0x80000000, -0x1400..0x8600

args.name: volume
args.meaning: added to the cry volume, result clamped to 0..127. aletheia's local name `pan` is wrong. Seen: 0, 127

args.name: chorusVolume
args.meaning: volume offset of a second voice. Nonzero 3 or 4 turns the second voice on. Seen: 0, 30, 60

args.name: chorusPitch
args.meaning: frequency offset of the second voice. Seen: -64, 0, 16

name: BallSource
title: Ball source
summary: Chooses whose Poke Ball the ball effects show: particle keys 3, 29 and 46..49 and the ball cell actor (command 69) follow that ball. Reset to 8 at script start.

args.name: source
args.allowed: 8 = the ball item set by the throw, 9 = the attacker's ball, other = the ball of the Pokemon at that position (0..13)

name: BallCellActorAtBattler
title: Ball cell actor at battler
summary: Loads the 2D cell actor of the ball chosen with BallSource (Dream Ball has its own) at a battler's screen point.

name: CallEffect
title: Call effect
summary: Runs another effect script as a subroutine, then returns here at its command 71. Saves attacker, defender and scriptVar, and sets scriptVar to 0.

args.name: effect
args.allowed: 0x231 and up (member effect - 0x231 of `a/0/6/7`). Lower ids load the wrong member

args.name: attacker
args.allowed: 14 = keep, else the new attacker position

args.name: defender
args.allowed: 16 = keep, else the new defender position

name: Return
title: Return
summary: Frees the called script and restores attacker, defender, scriptVar and the caller's script. No arguments. Only valid inside a script entered by 70.

args.name: offset
args.meaning: from the end of this command. Seen: -0x7E2..0x1DE

name: WaitForBattle
title: Wait for battle
summary: Blocks until the battle code calls `BTLV_EFFECT_ResumeVm`. No arguments.

name: GoToEffect
title: Go to effect
summary: Replaces the running script with another one (no return), variant 0. Resets scriptVar.

args.name: effect
args.allowed: effect id. Below 0x231 = move script in `a/0/6/6`, else `a/0/6/7` member id - 0x231

name: ReleaseSideSprites
title: Release side sprites
summary: Starts a task that, for every loaded sprite on one side, resumes its animation and shows its shadow once the sprite is idle. The script does not wait for it.

args.name: side
args.allowed: 0 = even positions (player side), other = odd positions

name: BlinkDrawOrder
title: Blink draw order
summary: Sets the "draw blink layer last" flag of every loaded Pokemon sprite.

args.name: mode
args.allowed: 1 = set the flag on positions 3, 4 (double) or 2, 5, 6 (triple), clear it elsewhere. Other = clear on all

name: EndScript
title: End
summary: Ends the script. Frees particles, cell actors and buffers, puts sprites back on their spots, restores BG, blending and sound, then may start a pending or fallback script. No arguments.

name: PlaySoundByName
title: Play sound by name
summary: Plays a mod's sound sequence by its `<mod>:<seq>` name (eidos). Put the name in the script with `text "mod:seq"` under a label. An unknown name plays nothing.

args.name: volume
args.meaning: player volume (`NNS_SndHandleSetVolume`). Vanilla often starts at 0 and raises it with 55. Seen: 0..127

args.name: modDepth
args.meaning: track modulation depth. 0 = do not touch modulation. Seen: 0, 5..200, 2000

args.name: modSpeed
args.meaning: track modulation speed, only used when modDepth is not 0. Seen: 0..127

name: ParticleColor
title: Tint particles
summary: Tints every emitter of a loaded particle file, later ones too, until the file unloads or the script ends (eidos). The tint multiplies the particles' own colours.

args.name: source
args.meaning: where the colour comes from: 0 = `value` as BGR555, 1 = the type numbered by the variant (Judgment, and added Techno Blast drives from variant 17; the game's drives 1 to 4 need 2 with their type), 2 = type `value`, 3 = the playing move's type. A type's colour is its `color` in types.txt

args.name: value
args.allowed: BGR555 (source 0; 7FFF removes the tint), a type (source 2), else 0
